rules: Keep the reviewed light-only surface and four-step request accordion.
Run make light-check (MUST-FOLLOW rule 13) in the deploy's build step, after the release guard: no dark panel, no dark palette, color-scheme only light.
Preserve the later track readiness, refusal details and read-after-write fixes.
Run isolated browser checks under both OS color preferences before a fresh production build.
The release operator must re-read Cloudflare and require expected_live_version unchanged immediately before deploy.
Read back the deployed surface-release.json and every compiled asset hash after deployment.
This local gate cannot prevent another checkout or credential holder from bypassing the release process.
